claims: Artemis II is carrying four astronauts.
Artemis II is a 10-day mission to fly around the Moon and return to Earth.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to the lunar vicinity since 1972.
The Artemis II crew will test the Orion spacecraft's systems in deep space.
The Artemis II crew will swing around the far side of the Moon.
The Artemis II crew will splash down in the Pacific Ocean.
The destination of Artemis II is a lunar flyby orbiting the Moon rather than landing.
The duration of Artemis II is approximately 10 days.
The crew of Artemis II includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch.
The crew of Artemis II includes Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II trajectory includes a high-speed return.
Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
Artemis II is designed to verify that the Orion capsule and Space Launch System (SLS) rocket can safely transport humans to deep space and return them to Earth.
